sourceCopy: No new upstream implementation or tests copied. Historical attribution retained.
validation: All 1834 canonical icons render the same SVG as lucide-react@1.45.0 with default and non-scaling strokes.
Complete root/alias/dynamic-name export comparisons and generation check.
Focused data, types, SSR/hydration and lifecycle tests; bounded parity remains explicit.
limitations: This dependency maintenance does not claim exhaustive upstream test-suite parity.

performance.scenario: One named Camera import, production minification with Octane external; same 1000-icon SSR batch after 1000 warmups, 15 samples.
performance.interpretation: The named bundle grows by 495 gzip bytes for the current framework-neutral builder. CPU sample ranges overlap; no speedup or slowdown is established. Markup and icon/React reachability controls pass.

compatibility: CircleEuroSign, CircleEuroSignIcon and LucideCircleEuroSign remain aliases for CircleEuro, including the icons namespace, direct subpath and dynamic import.
__iconNode remains a deprecated alias for __iconData.node on generated icon modules.
